title: Count All Maze Paths
statement:
Given an N×M grid where 0 means open and 1 means a wall, count the total number of paths from the top-left cell (0,0) to the bottom-right cell (N-1,M-1).

You can move in 4 directions (up, down, left, right). You cannot revisit cells in the same path. You cannot step on walls.
constraints:
1 <= N, M <= 5
Grid cells are 0 (open) or 1 (wall).
Guaranteed start and end are open (0).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and M.
The next N lines each contain M space-separated integers (0 or 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of distinct paths from (0,0) to (N-1,M-1).

examples.explanation: The center is blocked; 2 paths exist around it.
